youtube_description:
Hey guys!  Trey and I flew into Las Vegas, rented a small van to sleep in, and took a road trip to Zion National Park and Bryce Canyon.  It was amazing!  We camped most of the time at Red Cliffs National Preserve.  Why?  Because the National Park campgrounds were full.  What a treasure we found!  11 campsites and tons of amazing hikes and views for $20 a night!  There is also a lot of free camping land through the bureau of land management.  

Watch all 3 episodes of our adventures.  This is episode 3.  Click below to watch the other episodes.

EPISODE #1. https://youtu.be/9d7cu5HGvZc
EPISODE #2. https://youtu.be/0Q6vI711rFg

Episode 1 highlights our hiking in Red Cliffs National Preserve, and of course there has to be some food involved!

episode 2 highlights Bryce canyons famous Queens Garden and Navajo trails and more food at the campground in Bryce.

Episode 3 highlights "The Narrows" which is river hiking at its best.  Not recommended for people that are not athletic or sure on their feet!

Hope you all enjoy our travels!!!
